summary: Redact quoted credentials and authorization in standalone startup reports.
details: The standalone collector handles quoted credentials, Basic/Bearer authorization, home paths and email text while preserving prior unquoted suffix-key handling. Mod-list text uses the same local redactor; hashes describe captured redacted bytes and the manifest records mod-list changes.

Consumed release-asset controls execute the actual script under PowerShell 7 and Windows PowerShell 5.1 on Windows. Synthetic cases cover preserved diagnostics and inputs, valid quoted JSON, tail and mod-list limits, excluded payloads and repeated redaction.

The self-contained two-file collector and frozen-source bundle identity remain separate from player packages. These controls do not prove universal privacy or native Factorio behavior; actual candidate qualification, release readback and review before sharing remain required.
